basic.name: Lightning Fury
basic.description: Hurl a lightning javelin that deals 158~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit and splits into two lightning bolts that deal 158~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in their path.

basic.name: Blinding Light
basic.description:
After 0.5 seconds, deal 50~~0.04~~ damage and Blind enemies in the target area for 2 seconds.

Passive: Cassia deals 15% increased damage to Blinded targets.

basic.name: Fend
basic.description: Charge at an enemy, and upon arriving Channel for up to 1.5 seconds, dealing 64~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in front of Cassia every 0.25 seconds. Deals 50% reduced damage to non-Heroes. Avoidance remains charged while Channeling.

heroic.name: Ball Lightning
heroic.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit.

heroic.name: Valkyrie
heroic.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

trait.name: Avoidance
trait.description:
While moving, Cassia gradually gains up to 30 Armor over 3 seconds. After being stationary for 0.75 seconds, the Armor is rapidly lost over .5 seconds. 

Avoidance remains charged while Fending.

trait.name: Avoidance
trait.description:
While moving, Cassia gradually gains up to 30 Armor over 3 seconds. After being stationary for 0.75 seconds, the Armor is rapidly lost over .5 seconds. 

Avoidance remains charged while Fending.

activable.name: Inner Light
activable.description: Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit with Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.

activable.name: Rockstopper
activable.description:
Activate to fully charge Avoidance and increase its Armor value to 60 for 4 seconds.  

Losing Avoidance removes this bonus.

level1.name: Thunderstroke
level1.description:
Increase the damage of Lightning Fury by 20.

Quest: Lightning Fury's damage is increased by 1.5 every time it hits a Hero.

level1.name: Impale
level1.description: Increase Fend's cast range and radius by 25%. It deals an additional 70% damage to enemies below 50% Health.

level1.name: Charged Strikes
level1.description: Gain 15% Attack Speed. Every 3rd Basic Attack deals 20% bonus damage and bounces to nearby enemy Heroes.

level4.name: Plate of the Whale
level4.description: Regenerate 6~~0.04~~ Health per second while Avoidance is active. If fully charged, gain an additional 12~~0.04~~ Health per second.

level4.name: Ring of the Leech
level4.description: Basic Attacks against your primary target heal for 20% of their damage. If an enemy is Blinded, this also affects Lightning Fury and Fend.

level4.name: Inner Light
level4.description: Activate to heal for 25% of your maximum Health over 5 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit with Lightning Fury lower the cooldown of this ability by 10 seconds.

level7.name: Grounding Rod
level7.description: Enemies hit by Lightning Fury or Fend are Slowed by 20% for 2 seconds.

level7.name: Seraph's Hymn
level7.description:
Basic Attacks against your primary enemy Hero grant 10 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Blinding Light by 2 seconds.

Passive: Increase the passive damage bonus of Blinding Light from 15% to 30%.

level7.name: Surge of Light
level7.description: After taking 650~~0.04~~ damage with Avoidance active, Cassia can activate Avoidance to deal 220~~0.04~~ damage to enemies around her.

level10.name: Ball Lightning
level10.description: Throw a ball of lightning at an enemy Hero that bounces up to 6 times between nearby enemy Heroes and Cassia, dealing 180~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit.

level10.name: Valkyrie
level10.description: Summon a Valkyrie that rushes to Cassia after 0.75 seconds, pulling the first enemy Hero hit, dealing 225~~0.04~~ damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds at the end of her path. The Valkyrie knocks back all other enemy Heroes in her way.

level13.name: War Matron
level13.description: Cassia becomes Protected while Channeling Fend and for an additional 1 second if the Channel is completed.

level13.name: War Traveler
level13.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 10% Movement Speed and Mounting is instant.

level13.name: Gloves Of Alacrity
level13.description: Gain 1 Basic Attack range. While Avoidance is fully charged, gain an additional 1 Basic Attack range.

level16.name: Power Strike
level16.description: Lightning Fury pierces but only splits on Heroes. Enemy Heroes hit reduce its cooldown by 1 second and become marked for 15 seconds. Upon reaching 3 marks, remove them and cast a Blinding Light at their feet.

level16.name: Static Electricity
level16.description: Gain 2 additional charges of Lightning Fury. Fend's impact launches a lightning bolt towards each nearby enemy Hero.

level16.name: Martial Law
level16.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health. Increase this to 3% if they are Stunned, Rooted, Slowed, or Blinded.

level20.name: Infinite Lightning
level20.description: Ball Lightning can now bounce indefinitely. Every bounce reduces its cooldown by 4 seconds.

level20.name: Imprisoning Light
level20.description: Upon impaling an enemy Hero, they are Blinded for 5 seconds and Cassia's Valkyrie creates a wave of light that deals 200~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. This wave Silences and Roots them for 3 seconds.

level20.name: Titan's Revenge
level20.description: Cassia's Basic Attacks now ignore Armor and while Avoidance is fully charged, they deal an additional 20% bonus damage.

level20.name: Rockstopper
level20.description:
Activate to fully charge Avoidance and increase its Armor value to 60 for 4 seconds.  

Losing Avoidance removes this bonus.
